lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with roughly four to five spots per column forming a regular 2D grid pattern across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a coordinate-like grid where the spots serve as anchor nodes on the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-colored pixels on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow-line below it.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more organized spots on the lateral flank.
